I'm 42 years old, been farming these 8 mu in Quzhou since I was 17. My father taught me everything. I only finished primary school, but I know this land and I know what works. Last year my wheat gave about 1,000 jin per mu and maize about 1,200 jin. This year I'll do what I did last year — change is risky and a bad harvest is a disaster I can't afford.

For wheat, I rotary till the land in early October before sowing. I buy improved wheat seed from the dealer in town, about 30 jin per mu — it's the same kind my neighbors use, Liangxing or Shimai, whatever the bag looks like from last year. For fertilizer, I put down two bags of compound fertilizer per mu as base. That's 100 kg of the 18-22-5 formula, about 130 yuan per bag. Then in March when the wheat turns green, I broadcast one bag of urea per mu, 50 kg. That's another 50 yuan or so. So in total that's about 41 kg of nitrogen per mu. I know fertilizer is expensive — over 300 yuan per mu just for fertilizer — but cutting back is not worth the risk. I irrigate three times: once before winter so the wheat survives the cold, once at jointing in April when the stems shoot up, and once at grain filling in May. I spray herbicide once right after sowing, and insecticide twice — once in spring and once if I see aphids in late May. I expect about 1,100 jin per mu, around 550 kg, if the weather holds.

For maize, right after I cut the wheat in early June, I plant maize with the no-till seeder. There's no time to plow — you have to get the seed in the ground before the soil dries out, and it saves diesel money too. I use hybrid seed, one package per mu, usually Nongda or whatever the dealer recommends. Costs about 50-60 yuan per package. I put two bags of high-nitrogen compound fertilizer per mu as base — 100 kg of the 28-6-6 kind. I don't topdress maize. The compound has enough nitrogen and if the summer rains come I don't need more. Last year I didn't topdress and still got good yield. That's about 28 kg nitrogen per mu. I irrigate twice — once after planting if June is dry, and once at filling in August. Herbicide once after sowing, insecticide twice because corn borer shows up some years and you can't let that happen. No tillage for maize. I expect about 1,150 jin per mu, around 575 kg.

With seven people in the house and my son working in the city sending some money home, we have a little cash, but every yuan counts. Diesel, seed, fertilizer — it all adds up to over 2,000 yuan for the season. Still, I'd rather spend a bit too much on fertilizer than lose yield. My neighbor Wang uses about the same amounts, so I'm not changing anything. If everyone around me does something and it works, I do it too.
